prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Katy, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1028; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the rear-end collision you were involved in recently in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was stopped at a red light in the right lane on a main road. The traffic had been moving slowly, and I had come to a complete stop. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car was pushed forward into the intersection.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No, I didn't. I was looking ahead at the light and I never saw it coming in my mirror.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They diagnosed me with whiplash and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatory medication. I've also started physical therapy twice a week.

Q: How would you describe your symptoms right now?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to check traffic. I get headaches most afternoons, and my shoulders ache when I'm driving for more than about twenty minutes.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I missed a few days at the start, and since then I've been working reduced hours because sitting at my desk for long periods makes the pain worse.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to make sure my treatment is covered and that the repair shop has my vehicle information on file.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
